Spatial Co-occurrence

Co-occurrence score (conditional probability ratio) of each cell type co-occurring with the most abundant type across increasing radii. Scores > 1 indicate spatial enrichment at that distance.

Co-occurrence scores vs distance

Neighbourhood Enrichment

Permutation-based test (1000 permutations) on the spatial adjacency graph. High z-scores indicate cell type pairs that are more often neighbours than expected by chance. Negative values indicate spatial exclusion.

Enrichment data computed but plot could not be rendered (check logs for details).

Ligand-Receptor Communication

Permutation test (CellPhoneDB-like) for ligand-receptor interactions between spatially co-localised cell types, using the OmniPath database. Bar chart shows the top 20 pairs ranked by −log₁₀(p). Dotplot is restricted to the 6 cell types with the most significant interactions.

8,356 interactions at p < 0.001 (21,452 at p < 0.05) across 36 cell-type pairs.

SVG Pathway Enrichment (GSEA)
